name: Six of Pentacles
keywords: the receiving side and the giving side

facts.merchant-scale: A merchant in a red cloak holds a pair of scales in one hand.
facts.dropping-coins: With the other hand he drops coins into the open hand of a kneeling person.
facts.two-kneeling: Two people kneel before the merchant; one receives, and one holds out a hand and waits.
facts.six-pentacles: Six pentacles float in the air above.
facts.town: A town can be seen far off on the right.

glosses.merchant-scale: A standard for measuring how much to give; the balance of give and take.
glosses.two-kneeling: One who receives and one who waits; the order and the standard of sharing.

reversedGloss.blocked: Help does not reach where it is needed, or cannot be asked for.
reversedGloss.excess: The giving side and the receiving side harden, and the relationship tilts.

misdescriptions.wrong: The scales tilt heavily to one side.
The merchant is taking their money.
